therapist.title: Welcome to your practice, {name}
therapist.intro: Here you keep your appointments and your room in one place. It works on your phone, tablet and computer. Take your time; we'll help you if anything is unclear.

step1.title: Your calendar
step1.text: See your appointments for today and this week. Tap an appointment to see the details.

step2.title: Room blocks
step2.text: Reserve a room for the times you want to work. Clients can then book you online in those times.

step3.title: Settings
step3.text: Add your treatments, prices and working hours, so clients see the right information.

therapist.help: Questions or stuck? Call <phone></phone> or email <email></email>. We're happy to help.

admin.title: Welcome, {name}
admin.intro: This is where you run the centre: rooms, renters and rent. Everything is in the menu at the top.

step1.title: Room grid
step1.text: See at a glance which rooms are reserved, by whom and when.

step2.title: Rooms and renters
step2.text: Add rooms and therapists, and choose who rents which room.

step3.title: Rent
step3.text: Set the rent per room: a fixed amount per month or a price per block.

admin.help: Questions or stuck? Call <phone></phone> or email <email></email>. We're happy to help.

client.title: Welcome, {name}
client.intro: This is your own page at The Hague Natural Health Centre. Here you find everything about your appointments.

step1.title: Your appointments
step1.text: Below you see your upcoming and past appointments, with the date, time and therapist.

step2.title: Book
step2.text: Want a new appointment? Press the green button Book an appointment. You choose a treatment, a day and a time.

step3.title: Cancel
step3.text: Can't make it? Press Cancel appointment. You'll see first whether you get money back.

client.help: Questions or stuck? Call us on <phone></phone> or email <email></email>. We're happy to help.
